data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 54.854 million for the 2015 financial year, primarily impacting the 2011, 2012, and 2013 underwriting years, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The report notes mixed performance across business segments in 2015, with some deterioration in Marine, Aviation, Energy, Transportation, Financial, and Professional Lines, and favorable claims experience in Global Casualty. The syndicate's reserve setting involves judgments, statistical techniques, and ongoing review of estimates and margin adjustments, including IBNR recalibration.
raw_causal_phrases: good claims experience for Global Casualty during the year
The measurement of the provision for claims outstanding involves judgments and assumptions about the future
judgment is applied when estimating the value of amounts that should be provided for claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported (IBNR) to the Syndicate
The amount included in respect of IBNR is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by the Syndicate Managing Agent's in house actuaries and reviewed by external consulting actuaries

In setting claims provisions the Syndicate gives consideration to the probability and magnitude of future experience being more adverse than assumed and exercises a degree of caution in setting reserves where there is considerable uncertainty
As claims develop, and the ultimate cost of claims becomes more certain, the relative level of margin maintained should decrease
